evals.query: Audit my personal repo and leave it properly configured.
expected_behavior: Runs the audit in read-only mode before proposing changes.
Recommends TBD (main only, short branches, squash) because it is a personal repo, and explains why.
Presents the findings by severity and states what could not be checked.
Creates no files, runs no remote commands and changes nothing without an explicit OK.
Proposes the application plan on the internal/github-practices-setup branch with a draft PR.

evals.query: Protect the main branch of my repo.
expected_behavior: Shows the exact command that applies the ruleset to the default branch, with the TBD or Gitflow JSON depending on the repo model.
Shows how to list the ruleset to get its id and the command that undoes it.
Explains which rules it includes and warns that status checks are added after the workflow.
Asks for an explicit OK before running and runs nothing in that turn.
If the repo is private without a compatible plan and the API returns 403, declares it instead of failing.

evals.query: Is the branch feature/login valid for the repo my-repo?
expected_behavior: Uses scripts/branch_name.py to validate the branch against the repo name, instead of answering from memory.
Reports that the issue is missing and that the expected format is <prefix>/<ISSUE>-<context>.
Proposes a valid alternative, for example feature/GH-12-login, and checks the 63 character limit with the repo name.
Explains that internal/, revert/ and automated/ are the only prefixes that may go without an issue.
